summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Hecate killed with torches in the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Clytius among the Giants destroyed when the Olympians fought with Heracles at their side: Hecate killed him with torches. The revolt of the earthborn belongs to the Giants together; Clytius is one of those named in Apollodorus' battle roll.
